usedFor: Brevo holds your contacts and Perplexity answers questions, so “Contact Updated” can feed “Chat Completion” for a written reply.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Updated” in Brevo, then “Chat Completion” in Perplexity
bestTemplate.why: The changed contact details become the prompt, so Perplexity can draft a summary or research note for that person.

watchOut: “Contact Updated” in Brevo fires on every change, so “Chat Completion” can run again for the same contact.
